articles.title: Wells Fargo Names Faraz Shafiq as Head of AI Products and Solutions
articles.mainIdea: Wells Fargo Names Faraz Shafiq as Head of AI Products and Solutions
articles.summary: Business Wire: Wells Fargo Names Faraz Shafiq as Head of AI Products and Solutions. SAN FRANCISCO, January 26, 2026--Wells Fargo & Company (NYSE: WFC) today announced the appointment of Faraz Shafiq as Head of AI Products and Solutions, effective Feb. 9. This move demonstrates the bank’s commitment to leveraging artificial intelligence (AI) to shape the future of financial services and transform how it works to deliver for employees, customers, and communities.
